title: First-diversion bounds

bodyBlocks.text: First-diversion window: after 15:02 and by 15:10 case time. Subtracting the four-minute fast-clock offset converts service 15:06 to case 15:02 and service 15:14 to case 15:10. The lower bound is open; the upper bound is included. A later transport event cannot be the first diversion already observed by 15:10.
